name: dsh-ide-workbench-monorepo
description: Monorepo of the DSH IDE workbench (core) and the DSH code intelligence plugin (codeintel). The repository name and the plugin ID of the core are unchanged (PRD-v6 D4).

scripts.build: npm run sync:contract && npm run build --workspace packages/workbench && npm run build --workspace packages/codeintel
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/workbench && npm run test --workspace packages/codeintel && npm run test:contract
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run verify:split
